title: Change Order Fee Pricing Standard for Design Studio Selections
content:
**Which change order is priced.** The change order recorded is the one whose option lines were added or removed most recently on the Design Studio Selections file. An error-correcting change order is recorded at 0.00 under the package's builder-error waiver and is not priced by this rule.

**When a fee is due.** A change order written at the buyer's request is fee-bearing when the buyer-requested change orders already recorded on the file number at least the package's free change orders; otherwise its fee is 0.00.

**Amount.** The change order fee of a fee-bearing change order is its schedule fee times the paid-order multiple, reduced by the studio-error relief percent, plus the change percent of its change amount, plus the lead-time surcharge, rounded half up to the cent once at the end. The schedule fee is the package's change order fee. The change amount is the price of the option lines the change order adds less the removal credits booked under it, never below zero. The paid-order multiple is one, the studio-error relief percent and the change percent are zero, and the lead-time surcharge is 0.00.

**Order of working.** The schedule fee is first multiplied by the paid-order multiple; that product is then reduced by the studio-error relief percent; the change percent part (the change percent of the change amount, a change amount below zero counting as zero) and the lead-time surcharge are added to the reduced amount. The relief never reduces the change percent part or the surcharge. Rounding to the cent happens once, on the final sum.

**Counting buyer-requested change orders.** The change order entries already on the file's design ledger whose reason is a buyer request are counted; the change order being priced is not yet among them.

**Worked figures (hypothetical package: change order fee 400.00, one free change order)**

| Buyer-requested change orders already recorded | Fee-bearing | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | No (0 is fewer than 1) | 0.00 |
| 1 | Yes (1 is at least 1) | 400.00 multiplied by one, reduced by 0 percent, plus 0 percent of the change amount, plus 0.00: 400.00 |
| 2 | Yes | 400.00 |
